# X2000片上外设内核驱动

## 1. UART

### 1.1 uart 配置

1、menuconfig 配置

```c
在电脑端输入 make menuconfig 进入配置菜单

kernel/kernel-x2000$ make menuconfig

Ingenic device-drivers Configurations → [UART] Drivers 
             <*> ingenic serial port support                                                                                     
             [*]   Console on ingenic soc and compatible serial port                                                             
             [*]   ingenic baudrate add support greater than 1M  
```

2、设备树配置

```c
文件路径：arch/mips/boot/dts/ingenic/x2000-v12.dtsi
uart0: serial@0x10030000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10030000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART0>;
    clocks = <&extclk 0>;
    clock-names = "uart0";
};
uart1: serial@0x10031000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10031000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART1>;
};
uart2: serial@0x10032000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10032000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART2>;
};
uart3: serial@0x10033000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10033000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART3>;
};

uart4: serial@0x10034000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10034000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART4>;
    status = "disabled";
};
uart5: serial@0x10035000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10035000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART5>;
    status = "disabled";
};
uart6: serial@0x10036000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10036000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART6>;
    status = "disabled";
};
uart7: serial@0x10037000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10037000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART7>;
    status = "disabled";
};

uart8: serial@0x10038000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10038000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART8>;
    status = "disabled";
};
uart9: serial@0x10039000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,8250-uart";
    reg = <0x10039000 0x100>;
    reg-shift = <2>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_UART9>;
    status = "disabled";
};
```

### 1.2 更换uart流程

1、更改uboot配置流程

```c
文件路径：include/configs/x2000_base.h
在文件中添加需要配置的串口定义
#define CONFIG_SYS_UART_INDEX	4
```

2、更改设备树配置

```c
文件路径：arch/mips/boot/dts/ingenic/x2000_module_base.dts
在文件中添加需要配置的串口
&uart4 {
	status = "okay";
	pinctrl-names = "default";
	pinctrl-0 = <&uart4_pc>;	// 串口引脚
};

串口引脚定义
文件路径：arch/mips/boot/dts/ingenic/x2000-pinctrl.dtsi
uart4_pin: uart4-pin {
    uart4_pa: uart4-pa {
        ingenic,pinmux = <&gpa 0 3>;
        ingenic,pinmux-funcsel = <PINCTL_FUNCTION1>;
    };
    uart4_pc: uart4-pc {
        ingenic,pinmux = <&gpc 9 12>;
        ingenic,pinmux-funcsel = <PINCTL_FUNCTION3>;
    };
};
```

### 1.3 修改uart的波特率

```c
文件路径：include/configs/x2000_base.h
在文件中添加需要定义的串口的波特率
#define CONFIG_BAUDRATE			3000000  // 更改的波特率
```

### 1.4 关闭串口打印

1、关闭所有打印

```c
文件路径：include/configs/x2000_base.h
屏蔽CONFIG_SPL_SERIAL_SUPPORT宏关闭uboot串口打印
/*#define CONFIG_SPL_SERIAL_SUPPORT*/
```

2、关闭uboot打印

```
文件路径：include/configs/x2000_base.h
定义CONFIG_ARG_NO_CONSOLE宏关闭uboot串口打印
#define CONFIG_SPL_SERIAL_SUPPORT
```

2、关闭kernel打印

```c
在电脑端输入 make menuconfig 进入配置菜单
Kernel hacking  --->
    [ ] Early printk
```

### 1.5 uart 增加串口调试信息打印

```c
文件路径：include/configs/x2000_base.h
屏蔽CONFIG_ARG_QUIET宏 打开串口全部打印
/*#define CONFIG_ARG_QUIET*/
```


```c
[    0.027352] 10031000.serial: ttyS1 at MMIO 0x10031000 (irq = 54, base_baud = 9375000) is a uart1
[    0.027970] 10032000.serial: ttyS2 at MMIO 0x10032000 (irq = 53, base_baud = 9375000) is a uart2
[    0.159062] 10033000.serial: ttyS3 at MMIO 0x10033000 (irq = 52, base_baud = 9375000) is a uart3
[    0.168391] 10034000.serial: ttyS4 at MMIO 0x10034000 (irq = 51, base_baud = 9375000) is a uart4

[    0.028366] console [ttyS4] enabled
```

```c
# cat /dev/ttyS4 &
# echo "this is serial test string" > /dev/ttyS4
this is serial test string
```

## 2. RTC

### 2.1 rtc 配置

1、menuconfig 配置

```c
在电脑端输入 make menuconfig 进入配置菜单
Device Drivers  --->
    Ingenic device-drivers Configurations > [RTC] drivers  --->
    [*] Real Time Clock  --->
        <*>   INGENIC RTC
```

2、设备树配置

```c
文件路径：arch/mips/boot/dts/ingenic/x2000-v12.dtsi
rtc: rtc@0x10003000 {
    compatible = "ingenic,rtc";
    reg = <0x10003000 0x4c>;
    interrupt-parent = <&core_intc>;
    interrupts = <IRQ_RTC>;
    system-power-controller;
    power-on-press-ms = <1000>;
    status = "ok";
};
```

### 2.2 rtc 测试

1、rtc 测试配置

```c
在电脑端输入 make menuconfig 进入配置菜单
Device Drivers  --->
    Ingenic device-drivers Configurations > [RTC] drivers  --->
    [*] Real Time Clock  --->
        <*>   INGENIC RTC
        [*]     Ingenic RTC suspend test
        (60)      Ingenic RTC suspend alarm time Unit of second
```

2、测试

```c
编译进入内核，进行休眠唤醒一段时间
echo mem > sys/power/state （休眠60秒后自动唤醒－（测试点为定时和计时准确以及唤醒功能））
```
